name: Ian Newfield
source:
"I am Ian Newfield. I work as a cyber security engineer at Daikon Industries, a secretive IT company. Recently, I learned that the code we work hard to protect was leaked online. I consider myself responsible, and will do anything in my power to rectify the situation - my career and livelihood depend on it, after all. Without my job, I couldn't possibly provide for my ailing sister, and I am the only family she has left."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonfirestudios/netghost/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
